project.name: Theatrum
project.description: A powerful streaming server built in Go supporting Video on Demand (VOD) with adaptive bitrate streaming, multiple quality profiles, HLS protocol, and live RTMP streaming.

structure.src/domain/models: Domain entities (Stream, Quality, Application, Server, Distribution)
structure.src/domain/services: Business logic services (ApplicationService, StreamService, EncodeService, PathTemplateService)
structure.src/domain/jobs: Background job processing (encoding queue, video detection)
structure.src/adapters/driven: Implementations of port interfaces (ffmpegEncoder, fileAccess, yamlConfigFile)

rtmp.flow: RTMP Client -> RTMP Server -> Handler -> Authorization -> StreamManager -> FFmpeg -> HLS output
